div.div:
Notes
*1 A backup restores only into the Region it is stored in
Restoring in Osaka needs a file system and an SVM there, and creating them lands on the RTO (20 minutes measured; ap-northeast-3, SINGLE_AZ_1, 128 MBps)
*2 The native CopyBackup is manual and same-account only
Scheduling and cross-account copies go through AWS Backup, which requires AWS Organizations for the cross-account case
*3 This is not a replacement for SnapMirror
A minutes-level RPO and a failback procedure still mean holding a file system at the destination continuously
